summary: No installer-harm behavior observed in codex-setup@1.0.1
details: Package codex-setup@1.0.1 was examined and no behavior indicative of a supply-chain attack was observed. No lifecycle scripts fetching or executing remote content, no reads of installer secrets (such as ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser profiles, or wallet stores), no environment-variable scraping, no hardcoded attacker-controlled network destinations, no obfuscated payloads, no backdoor or persistence mechanisms, and no silent-relay of caller-supplied data were identified. The package appears benign on the basis of the scanned contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
